tickets.title: University Email Registration
tickets.description:
As a Student, I want to register using my university email address, so that only verified students can access the marketplace.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Registration requires a valid .edu email address.
- The system verifies the email format.
- Accounts with non-.edu emails are rejected.
- PASS: A user with a valid .edu email can register successfully.
- FAIL: A user with a non-.edu email can create an account.

tickets.title: Barcode Item Listing
tickets.description:
As a Student, I want to scan a product barcode, so that item details can be filled automatically when creating a listing.

Acceptance Criteria:
- The camera can scan a barcode.
- Item information is retrieved automatically when available.
- Students can edit retrieved information before publishing.
- PASS: Item details are populated after a successful scan.
- FAIL: The system does not retrieve item information.

tickets.title: Safe Exchange Zone Selection
tickets.description:
As a Student, I want to choose a safe exchange zone before contacting a seller, so that meetups occur in approved locations.

Acceptance Criteria:
- The system displays approved exchange zones.
- A zone must be selected before chat becomes available.
- Selected zones are visible to both parties.
- PASS: Chat is enabled only after a zone is selected.
- FAIL: Users can chat without selecting a safe zone.

tickets.title: Auction Listing
tickets.description:
As a Student, I want to create an auction listing, so that buyers can compete by submitting bids.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Sellers can choose Auction as a listing type.
- Buyers can submit bids.
- The highest bid is displayed.
- PASS: The highest bid updates after a valid bid is placed.
- FAIL: Bids are not recorded correctly.

tickets.title: Manage Safe Exchange Zones
tickets.description:
As a Campus Safety Administrator, I want to manage approved safe exchange zones, so that students can meet in secure locations.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Administrators can add exchange zones.
- Administrators can update exchange zones.
- Administrators can remove exchange zones.
- PASS: Changes made by administrators are visible to users.
- FAIL: Updated exchange zones are not reflected in the system.

tickets.title: Security
tickets.description: Restrict marketplace access to verified university users through .edu email authentication.

tickets.title: Safety
tickets.description: Promote secure transactions by enforcing approved safe exchange zones for physical meetups.

tickets.title: Usability
tickets.description: Reduce listing effort through barcode scanning and streamlined item creation workflows.

analysis.ambiguity1:
Requirement: "We want the app to suggest Safe Exchange Zones for all physical meetups."

Why it is vague:
The requirement does not define how safe exchange zones are selected, how many locations should be suggested, or whether users are required to choose from the suggested locations. Without clear criteria, developers cannot implement the feature consistently.
analysis.ambiguity2:
Requirement: "I want to be able to auction items, not just set a fixed price."

Why it is vague:
The requirement does not define auction rules such as bidding duration, minimum bid increments, reserve prices, winner selection, or how ties are handled. These missing details make implementation unclear.
analysis.conflictSolution:
Conflict:
The Student Union President wants the marketplace to collect a 2% transaction fee to support club activities. However, the University Legal Team states that the university cannot process payments or handle money transfers between students.

Proposed Solution:
The platform should not process payments directly. Instead, students complete payments using external services such as Venmo or cash. The marketplace may provide links to approved third-party payment providers, while any optional service fee is handled outside the university-operated platform through a separate Student Union process.
analysis.nfr1: Security - Only users with a valid university .edu email address may register and access the marketplace.
analysis.nfr2: Safety - The system should encourage secure transactions by requiring users to select approved safe exchange zones before arranging meetups.
analysis.nfr3: Usability - Users should be able to create item listings quickly using barcode scanning with minimal manual data entry.
